name: Portfolio_Ahnaf
description: Hello, hope you're having a good day. This is my personal Portfolio and I'll be updating it while i am polishing my skills as well as learning.

paragraphs: A high-performance, developer-first portfolio built with React 19, Vite, and Framer Motion. This project features a sophisticated IDE-themed aesthetic, blending modern glassmorphism with classic developer terminal elements, interactive CLI controls, and comprehensive engineering showcases.
features: 🖥️ IDE-Themed UI & Design System: A unique asymmetric layout inspired by modern code editors (VS Code / JetBrains) with custom syntax-highlighted color tokens and hardware-accelerated glassmorphism.

💼 Enterprise Experience Showcase: Dedicated enterprise role breakdown as a Full-Stack Developer Intern at Periscale AI, featuring detailed cards for production e-commerce platforms and server-side analytics engines.
🔬 IEEE-Published Research & Citation Drawer: Dedicated academic showcase for peer-reviewed medical AI paper (3C-Net in IEEE Xplore) with 1-click BibTeX and APA citation copying drawers.
📄 Interactive In-Browser CV Modal: Full-featured resume preview modal with direct PDF download (AhnafRasheedCV.pdf), pop-out tab support, and Esc keyboard dismissal.
🎡 Dynamic Projects Showcase & Slider: Multi-category filterable project showcase with auto-play progress bar, pause-on-hover capability, live demo launches, and GitHub links.
